slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal of the investment plan to maximize the total amount of money available at the end of the three-year horizon?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly clarified the objective measure as total money available at the end of the three-year horizon, resolving whether 'earnings' should be interpreted as final wealth rather than leaving it implicit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot H1 is P2 and was addressed before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 hidden slots remained when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent clarified the objective interpretation and key timing/reinvestment mechanics before modeling. The single hidden slot H1 was adequately addressed, and the stopping point was appropriate given no unresolved P0/P1 hidden slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
